title: Cleft Sentences
completion_message: ¡Formidable! Las 'Cleft Sentences' son la mejor herramienta para persuadir y enfatizar. Usar 'What we need is...' o 'It was the CEO who...' demuestra que puedes dirigir la atención de tu audiencia exactamente hacia donde tú quieres.

parts.visual:
En inglés avanzado (C2), en lugar de subir la voz para enfatizar, cambiamos la estructura de la oración usando 'Cleft Sentences' (Oraciones hendidas). Consiste en dividir la oración en dos partes para resaltar una idea. 

1. It Cleft Sentences (It is/was + [Foco] + that/who/which): 
Normal: The CEO canceled the project. 
Énfasis en el CEO: IT WAS the CEO WHO canceled the project. 
Énfasis en el proyecto: IT WAS the project THAT the CEO canceled. 

Normal: We need more time. 
Énfasis en el tiempo: IT IS more time THAT we need.
parts.audio: Welcome to Cleft Sentences for Emphasis. In advanced English, instead of raising our voice to emphasize a point, we change the grammatical structure. We divide the sentence into two parts. Number 1: 'It' Cleft Sentences. The structure is: It is or It was, plus the focus, plus that or who. Normal sentence: The CEO canceled the project. To emphasize the CEO, say: IT WAS the CEO WHO canceled the project. To emphasize the project, say: IT WAS the project THAT the CEO canceled. Normal sentence: We need more time. Cleft sentence: IT IS more time THAT we need.

parts.visual:
2. Wh- Cleft Sentences (What / All + [Sujeto+Verbo] + is/was + [Foco]): 
Normal: We need a new strategy. 
Cleft (What): WHAT we need IS a new strategy. 

Normal: I just want a coffee. 
Cleft (All): ALL I want IS a coffee. (All = The only thing). 

3. Enfatizar acciones (What + Sujeto + do/did + is/was + [Verbo base]): 
Normal: He resigned immediately. 
Cleft: WHAT he did WAS resign immediately. 

4. The reason why / The place where / The person who: 
Ej: THE REASON WHY I called IS to apologize. 
Ej: THE PERSON WHO can help you IS the manager.
parts.audio: Number 2: 'Wh' Cleft Sentences using What or All. Normal: We need a new strategy. Cleft sentence: WHAT we need IS a new strategy. Normal: I just want a coffee. Cleft: ALL I want IS a coffee. Here, 'All' means 'The only thing'. Number 3: Emphasizing actions using 'did' and the base verb. Normal: He resigned immediately. Cleft sentence: WHAT he did WAS resign immediately. Number 4: Using phrases like The reason why, The place where, or The person who. For example: THE REASON WHY I called IS to apologize. Or: THE PERSON WHO can help you IS the manager. These structures command the listener's attention beautifully.

stages.title: Interactive Quiz
stages.description: Elige la estructura correcta de Cleft Sentence para enfatizar.

questions.question: Normal: John sent the email. -> Emphasis on John: ____ was John who sent the email.
questions.explanation: It Cleft Sentence: It was John who...

questions.question: Normal: We need more funding. -> Emphasis: ____ we need is more funding.
questions.explanation: Wh- Cleft: What we need is...

questions.question: Normal: I just want to finish this. -> Emphasis: ____ I want is to finish this.
questions.explanation: All (The only thing) I want is...

questions.question: Normal: The manager fired him. -> Emphasis on manager: It was the manager ____ fired him.
Normal: They bought a new server. -> Emphasis on server: It was a new server ____ they bought.
questions.explanation: It was a new server that...

questions.question: Normal: He ignored the warning. -> Emphasis on action: What he ____ was ignore the warning.
questions.explanation: What he did was + verbo base.

questions.question: Normal: I hate the commuting. -> Emphasis: What I ____ is the commuting.
Normal: We met in Tokyo. -> Emphasis on Tokyo: It ____ in Tokyo that we met.
Normal: You need to rest. -> Emphasis: The ____ thing you need to do is rest.
questions.explanation: The best (o only) thing you need to do is... (Ambas válidas, 'best' es común).

questions.question: ____ reason why I am here is to help you.
Normal: She loves the weather in Spain. -> Emphasis: ____ she loves about Spain is the weather.
questions.explanation: What she loves about Spain is...

questions.question: Normal: I called him yesterday. -> Emphasis on yesterday: It was yesterday ____ I called him.
questions.explanation: It was yesterday that... (En Clefts temporales se usa 'that' preferiblemente).

questions.question: Normal: They asked for a discount. -> Emphasis: What they ____ for was a discount.
Normal: He always complains. -> Emphasis: The person ____ always complains is him.
____ matters most is customer satisfaction. (Lo que más importa).
It ____ the marketing team that won the award.
questions.explanation: It was the marketing team that... (Pasado).

questions.question: Normal: I don't understand the software. -> Emphasis: What I don't understand ____ the software.
____ he did was completely ruin the presentation. (Lo que él hizo).
Normal: The budget caused the delay. -> Emphasis: ____ was the budget that caused the delay.
Normal: She wants a promotion. -> Emphasis: ____ she wants is a promotion.
questions.explanation: All she wants is... (All = What / The only thing).

stages.title: Written Expression
stages.description: Escribe la palabra clave de la Cleft Sentence.

questions.question: ____ we need is more time. (Lo que)
____ was the CEO who fired him. (Pronombre impersonal)
____ I want is a break. (Todo lo que / Lo único que)
It was John ____ made the mistake. (Quien)
What he ____ was resign. (Hizo)
The reason ____ I called is... (Por qué)
It was in Paris ____ we met. (Que)
What they asked for ____ a discount. (Era/Fue con W)
____ matters most is quality. (Lo que con W)
It is money ____ we need. (Que con T)

pairs.target: Fue John quien... (Énfasis en la persona)
Lo único que quiero es... (Énfasis en exclusividad)
Es el dinero lo que... (Énfasis en la cosa)
Lo que él hizo fue... (Énfasis en la acción)

pairs.source: The reason why I am here
pairs.target: La razón por la cual estoy aquí

stages.title: Listening Comprehension
stages.description: Escucha y selecciona la Cleft Sentence correcta.

questions.question: Listen carefully.
questions.tts_text: What we need is more time.
options: What we need is more time.
That we need is more time.
What we needed is more time.
What we need is more times.
questions.correct_answer: What we need is more time.

questions.question: Listen carefully.
questions.tts_text: It was the CEO who resigned.
options: It was the CEO who resigned.
It is the CEO who resigned.
He was the CEO who resigned.
It was a CEO who resigned.
questions.correct_answer: It was the CEO who resigned.

questions.question: Listen carefully.
questions.tts_text: All I want is an answer.
options: All I want is an answer.
What I want is an answer.
All I want is the answer.
All I wanted is an answer.
questions.correct_answer: All I want is an answer.

questions.question: Listen carefully.
questions.tts_text: What he did was call the police.
options: What he did was call the police.
What he does was call the police.
What he did is call the police.
What he did was called the police.
questions.correct_answer: What he did was call the police.

questions.question: Listen carefully.
questions.tts_text: The reason why I came is you.
options: The reason why I came is you.
The reason why I come is you.
A reason why I came is you.
The reason why I came was you.
questions.correct_answer: The reason why I came is you.

questions.question: Listen carefully.
questions.tts_text: It was in London that we met.
options: It was in London that we met.
It is in London that we met.
It was in London where we met.
It was London that we met.
questions.correct_answer: It was in London that we met.

questions.question: Listen carefully.
Listen carefully.
questions.tts_text: It was yesterday that it happened.
options: It was yesterday that it happened.
It is yesterday that it happened.
It was yesterday when it happened.
It was yesterday that it happens.
questions.correct_answer: It was yesterday that it happened.

questions.question: Listen carefully.
questions.tts_text: What I love about it is the price.
options: What I love about it is the price.
What I loved about it is the price.
What I love about it was the price.
That I love about it is the price.

questions.question: Listen carefully.
questions.tts_text: It is money that we need.
options: It is money that we need.
It was money that we need.
It is the money that we need.
questions.correct_answer: It is money that we need.
